bvn_04d3aa788016.speaker: narrator
bvn_04d3aa788016.text: The driver wouldn't take the bus past the bend. "Not in snow," he said. "Not that bend."

bvn_96442594f099.speaker: narrator
bvn_96442594f099.text: I told him someone was expecting me. I don't know why I said that.

bvn_c073166eb45e.speaker: narrator
bvn_c073166eb45e.text: A light, low over the snow. About as high as a car's lamp. It drifted toward the house, and waited for me to follow.

bvn_565b26dc16f2.speaker: narrator
bvn_565b26dc16f2.text: Someone was standing in the front window. Watching the lane.

bvn_6f65e69b931d.speaker: narrator
bvn_6f65e69b931d.text: Twelve years, and somebody was still paying for that bulb.

bvn_6c034c65c183.speaker: narrator
bvn_6c034c65c183.text: Footprints on the step, half filled with snow. One set. Going out.

bvn_249addc272d6.speaker: narrator
bvn_249addc272d6.text: The key was under the mat. Where I'd left it.

bvn_2c81c2b2494d.speaker: narrator
bvn_2c81c2b2494d.text: The hall clock, ticking. Right to the minute. Somebody had been winding it.

bvn_37d1bc5533bd.speaker: narrator
bvn_37d1bc5533bd.text: It wasn't locked. On the hook inside, Dad's coat. Snow on the shoulders, gone grey.

bvn_5f474a6cdb16.speaker: narrator
bvn_5f474a6cdb16.text: Grandma knitted with her eyes shut. She said her hands could see.

bvn_fd87f0eafaa7.speaker: narrator
bvn_fd87f0eafaa7.text: I'd lie on the rug and count the stitches until I couldn't.

bvn_0e87811ddafc.speaker: narrator
bvn_0e87811ddafc.text: Click, click, click. I fell asleep to it every night that winter.

bvn_fd0f1a8ddadd.speaker: narrator
bvn_fd0f1a8ddadd.text: I drew the house from the lane. Always with the porch light on.

bvn_d40a8d5a15b2.speaker: narrator
bvn_d40a8d5a15b2.text: Dad said nobody walks that lane in snow. "Not past the bend. That ditch has had two cars."

bvn_bf89e0945d8f.speaker: narrator
bvn_bf89e0945d8f.text: I always pretended to be asleep. I was good at it.

bvn_8ea19aa899ee.speaker: narrator
bvn_8ea19aa899ee.text: Three plates. Dad nearest the stove, so he could reach the kettle without getting up.

bvn_caccb6e6dbd9.speaker: narrator
bvn_caccb6e6dbd9.text: His keys on the nail by the door. "A man should be able to leave in the dark without looking," he said.

bvn_b330ffda4895.speaker: narrator
bvn_b330ffda4895.text: The radio. The kettle. Mum laughing at something he said.

bvn_b81730833587.speaker: narrator
bvn_b81730833587.text: When I spilled mine he'd slide his across without looking up. "Plenty more where that came from."

bvn_3b28c6740ddc.speaker: narrator
bvn_3b28c6740ddc.text: After the funeral nobody sat in her chair. Not even the cat.

bvn_0de9a69c4b3a.speaker: narrator
bvn_0de9a69c4b3a.text: Mum took Grandma's needles out of the basket and didn't put them back.

bvn_8661a581a596.speaker: narrator
bvn_8661a581a596.text: Mum, in the chair, in the dark.

bvn_e48e09d5b96c.speaker: narrator
bvn_e48e09d5b96c.text: Click. ... Click. Slower than Grandma. Never stopping.

bvn_20da391939d3.speaker: narrator
bvn_20da391939d3.text: "It's not good," she said, when she caught me watching. "It's just mine."

bvn_55092a12cc7c.speaker: narrator
bvn_55092a12cc7c.text: She'd never knitted in her life. That winter she learned. Badly. She didn't stop.

bvn_b5c545a358f2.speaker: narrator
bvn_b5c545a358f2.text: St. Brigid's School of Art. Forty places. One of them was mine.

bvn_f0344516d81e.speaker: narrator
bvn_f0344516d81e.text: The fees were more than Dad earned in a year. I did the sum on the back of the envelope.

bvn_1284327acc88.speaker: narrator
bvn_1284327acc88.text: Through the floor, the kitchen. Numbers.

bvm_1f9049bee9aa.speaker: dad
bvm_1f9049bee9aa.text: "...if the car goes. And the overtime..."

bvm_e027c0442d5f.speaker: mum
bvm_e027c0442d5f.text: "He can't know. Not till it's sure."

bvn_889dd1e548ac.speaker: narrator
bvn_889dd1e548ac.text: I showed Dad. He read it twice, folded it small, and put it in his shirt pocket. "We'll see," he said.

bvn_3b1196e733b2.speaker: narrator
bvn_3b1196e733b2.text: They thought I was asleep. I'd had a lot of practice.

bvn_ccb794e42131.speaker: narrator
bvn_ccb794e42131.text: I'd come down for water. I didn't go back up.

bvm_2c30cf87f0fe.speaker: dad
bvm_2c30cf87f0fe.text: Dad: "If he wants to go, then go—"

bvn_1ebbef1bb515.speaker: narrator
bvn_1ebbef1bb515.text: I took every drawing off the wall. Every house. Every porch light.

bvn_d7ae6c6f7154.speaker: narrator
bvn_d7ae6c6f7154.text: Paper is louder than you'd think. Nobody came up.

bvn_aaf166b7a9b6.speaker: narrator
bvn_aaf166b7a9b6.text: Rip. Rip. Rip. I wanted them to hear it.

bvn_766adb3605c2.speaker: narrator
bvn_766adb3605c2.text: Four little squares of tape left on the wall where it had been. I left those too.

bvn_ec302718c73b.speaker: narrator
bvn_ec302718c73b.text: One bag. The rest could stay.

bvn_8ba53708e5f0.speaker: narrator
bvn_8ba53708e5f0.text: Grandma's scarf was on the bed. I left it there. I wanted it to be the first thing she saw.

bvn_02d172131e8d.speaker: narrator
bvn_02d172131e8d.text: Don't think. If you think, you'll stay.

bvn_b18b52d01916.speaker: narrator
bvn_b18b52d01916.text: I closed it before I could change my mind.

bvn_a39f89cc79c3.speaker: narrator
bvn_a39f89cc79c3.text: She was in the hall. In her coat. As if she'd known all along.

bvm_9906c6b67ef9.speaker: mum
bvm_9906c6b67ef9.text: "Write to me. Just once. Just so I know you're—"

bvn_7db533749d24.speaker: narrator
bvn_7db533749d24.text: I didn't look back. I'd decided that on the stairs.

bvn_6d7c498bf847.speaker: narrator
bvn_6d7c498bf847.text: Snow coming in sideways. The last bus in forty minutes.

bvn_ae24c1572ddc.speaker: narrator
bvn_ae24c1572ddc.text: A car door. An engine that wouldn't catch, then did.

bvn_2041e4ab93eb.speaker: narrator
bvn_2041e4ab93eb.text: Headlights on the lane. I cut across the field so they wouldn't find me.

bvn_4f5acaa80da0.speaker: narrator
bvn_4f5acaa80da0.text: A long way behind me, a sound like a door slamming. I didn't turn round.

bvn_fe2dc6abc82d.speaker: narrator
bvn_fe2dc6abc82d.text: Her room. Bed made with hospital corners. Her coat gone from the hook.

bvn_b4a0e46430cb.speaker: narrator
bvn_b4a0e46430cb.text: Slippers by the bed. Lined up. Waiting.

bvn_f04e517dbcc2.speaker: narrator
bvn_f04e517dbcc2.text: I said her name, quietly. The house didn't answer.

bvn_e515adcedd7b.speaker: narrator
bvn_e515adcedd7b.text: Postcards. Forty-one. My name on every one. Under it, where the address goes: nothing.

bvm_ef9158bde0df.speaker: mum
bvm_ef9158bde0df.text: First winter: "Set your place at tea again. Your dad sat with it. He doesn't say much these days."

bvm_8b9f28ab51f3.speaker: mum
bvm_8b9f28ab51f3.text: Third winter: "Your dad won't let me touch the porch light. Says you'll want it on."

bvm_b0da76decf73.speaker: mum
bvm_b0da76decf73.text: Fifth winter: "Electric's gone up. He still won't let me touch the switch."

bvm_b9d36e66a186.speaker: mum
bvm_b9d36e66a186.text: Eighth winter: "They asked again if I want his coat taken down. I said he'll want it there when he comes in."

bvm_b11c4fa59c35.speaker: mum
bvm_b11c4fa59c35.text: Tenth winter: "Two cups in the morning. He lets his go cold. He always did."

bvm_cc42c1a60bba.speaker: mum
bvm_cc42c1a60bba.text: Twelfth winter: "In for some tests. Back Thursday. I've told your dad to keep the fire in."

bvn_8e73154486d2.speaker: narrator
bvn_8e73154486d2.text: Two cups on the table. One drunk. One full and cold, a skin on it.

bvn_93abc3a7c863.speaker: narrator
bvn_93abc3a7c863.text: The nail by the door was empty.

bvn_ec58b31281a9.speaker: narrator
bvn_ec58b31281a9.text: Under his cup, a receipt. St. Brigid's. Deposit: paid in full. Dated the Monday before I left.

bvn_f5df14c97afb.speaker: narrator
bvn_f5df14c97afb.text: My drawings were back on the wall.

bvn_200fb1162532.speaker: narrator
bvn_200fb1162532.text: Every house. Every porch light. Taped together. Far too much tape.

bvn_ed90b04f1f5f.speaker: narrator
bvn_ed90b04f1f5f.text: Nobody came up, I'd said. Somebody came up.

bvn_16eb7f2ece39.speaker: narrator
bvn_16eb7f2ece39.text: On the back, in Mum's writing: "For when he's back. Don't you dare throw these out." The second line was underlined twice.

bvn_3ea13b284d92.speaker: narrator
bvn_3ea13b284d92.text: I closed my eyes. This time I'd stay for the end of it.

bvm_91bb60d6cbf4.speaker: dad
bvm_91bb60d6cbf4.text: "He's old enough to make his own mistakes, and I won't—"

bvm_0ccad59372a2.speaker: dad
bvm_0ccad59372a2.text: "If he wants to go, then go—"

bvm_df1b5dce2b44.speaker: dad
bvm_df1b5dce2b44.text: "—and I'll drive him. I'm not having him walk that lane in the snow."

bvm_6de9b8ba213b.speaker: dad
bvm_6de9b8ba213b.text: "Christmas. I want to see his face."

bvn_e003fece1b94.speaker: narrator
bvn_e003fece1b94.text: He was half a sentence away.

bvn_96b8dda00e63.speaker: narrator
bvn_96b8dda00e63.text: The lane. Where I cut across the field.

bvn_63ea25d211cf.speaker: narrator
bvn_63ea25d211cf.text: Headlights behind me. Slowing at the bend.

bvn_4da57a3746cc.speaker: narrator
bvn_4da57a3746cc.text: Tyres on ice. A long scrape.

bvn_f6160a07ac2e.speaker: narrator
bvn_f6160a07ac2e.text: Then the horn. One long note.

bvn_9fcc4550dece.speaker: narrator
bvn_9fcc4550dece.text: The bend. The ditch. One headlight, still on.

bvn_804cb453df91.speaker: narrator
bvn_804cb453df91.text: One photo on her dresser, face down.

bvn_d826204bc978.speaker: narrator
bvn_d826204bc978.text: Something tucked into the back of the frame.

bvn_f3860507e687.speaker: narrator
bvn_f3860507e687.text: "I'm fine. I've got a room. A job. I still draw, sometimes."

bvn_364ef013a047.speaker: narrator
bvn_364ef013a047.text: I wrote it every winter. I never once sent it.

bvn_ef9bcb56f9fd.speaker: narrator
bvn_ef9bcb56f9fd.text: The fire was out. Nobody had kept it in.

bvn_2e2771ba9bf1.speaker: narrator
bvn_2e2771ba9bf1.text: Her pill box on the mantel. Thursday, still full. Friday. Saturday.

bvn_86ccb0fb387f.speaker: narrator
bvn_86ccb0fb387f.text: The light from the lane came in and settled by the grate. As if it had been coming here all along.

bvn_9a4b9b6a5523.speaker: narrator
bvn_9a4b9b6a5523.text: Nothing on the porch. Nothing in the lane. I listened anyway.

bvn_33030979593a.speaker: narrator
bvn_33030979593a.text: I gave it my letters. All twelve. The light from the bend went in after them, and didn't come out.

bvn_90f998d0690f.speaker: narrator
bvn_90f998d0690f.text: Footsteps on the porch. Slow. Careful of the ice.

bvn_6533a63d6216.speaker: narrator
bvn_6533a63d6216.text: Dad's coat is still on the hook. We'll take it down together. Not tonight.

bvn_658e109b9b44.speaker: narrator
bvn_658e109b9b44.text: I never heard the end of it.

bvn_7acfb4d221ab.speaker: narrator
bvn_7acfb4d221ab.text: But this time, I didn't leave.
